_comment: The Guild's works (v0.60.0; design-progression.md stage 6a). User: TAG improves what it thinks needs improving, paid for by dues; the player can pay into any project; rivals add a trickle (Animal Crossing style); the hall itself changes; a plaque records who paid. projects: in the Guild's order of priority (its focus is the first unfinished tier). Each tier: cost, effect (read by game/works.py), changes (tiles set relative to the hall's corner, ;hall= in city.txt), people (folk placed relative to it) and windows (service windows: [dx, dy, folk], v0.84.0). COSTS, EFFECTS, NAMES AND PLACES ARE PLACEHOLDERS.

stash_room.name: The stash room
stash_room.what: More room in the guild stash.

quartermaster.name: The quartermaster
quartermaster.what: A quartermaster in the stash room, selling better supplies than the market.

training_corner.name: The training corner
training_corner.what: Training dummies and better teaching: every trainer charges less.

infirmary.name: The infirmary
infirmary.what: Cots in the stash room: the healer charges less, and minor injuries mend sooner.

dormitory.name: The dormitory
dormitory.what: Bunks for Hunters home from a hunt: a shorter rest.

archive_wing.name: The archive wing
archive_wing.what: Shelves for the Guild's archive: field notes pay half again, and the bestiary fills in sooner.

cartographers_study.name: The Cartographer's Study
cartographers_study.what: A small room off the front hall where the Guild's cartographer turns scouting reports into maps, sold at his window.

wayfinder_study.name: The Wayfinder study
wayfinder_study.what: A Guild scholar of the Wayfinder's words, who'll teach you one you don't know, for a fee.

armoury.name: The armoury
armoury.what: Loaner gear: each new Hunter starts with an arming sword (or a longbow) and a studded jerkin.
